notes: Easier from the first day. Log food without knowing calories (tap Estimate), train on rest days with Train anyway, and get a reminder offer after your first workouts. Reps and weight carry to the next set, the rest timer survives leaving a workout, XP and badges now count straight away, badges show how close you are, and setup suggests a plan that fits your equipment. Fixed: scrolling over a +/- button no longer changes the value, the plan editor opens on the right day, and a key typed during setup is kept. Many clearer words, in English and Arabic.
